d:
Sundarlal hidden from Jethalal, Tapu conceals him under the mattress and balances it with teddy bears. When Jethalal enters to give Tapu herbal Holi colors, he becomes suspicious of the squeaking sounds from the toys, but Daya distracts him with dinner before he can discover Sundar.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
